title: C: Semver Parser
description: Parse semantic version strings (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) and compare them.

steps.title: Parse and Compare Versions
steps.description: Define a `Semver` struct with major, minor, patch ints. Write `int semver_parse(Semver *v, char *s)` that parses a version string. Write `int semver_cmp(Semver *a, Semver *b)` that returns -1, 0, or 1. Test with '1.2.3' vs '1.10.0'.
hints: Compare major first, then minor, then patch.
